warningCountContext.interpretation: The single-item tranche separates an ethics competence item from its duplicate partner by testing a current-purpose decision under APA Ethics Code Standard 9.08, with the protected B key retained.

items.sourceCheck: The official APA Ethics Code states the two Standard 9.08 restrictions: decisions and recommendations may not rest on results outdated for the current purpose or on measures that are obsolete and not useful for that purpose. The revision applies the first restriction without turning test age into an automatic expiration rule.

limitations: Editorial/source review is not psychometric calibration, item-response analysis, or independent licensed-psychologist validation.
